method: Procedural pixel drawing: every card and battle pose is drawn as its own transparent 4x RGBA source frame, reduced once with Pillow NEAREST to the target cell, then assembled in row-major order. No sheet is resized as a whole.

references.fallback: Seq 4, as explicitly allowed by section 1

style: Top-down 3/4 pixel art for an atmospheric Victorian mystery game. Crisp hard-edged pixels, no antialiasing, blur, gradients, text or backdrop. One-pixel #1a1c2c outline. Muted game palette, warm amber holy light, turquoise sparingly. Transparent background and binary alpha.

path_prompts.prompt: Keep the dark brass lantern-bodied creature and three-pane silhouette. Make six amber light-ribbon wings, each ending in a small lantern flame; the open central housing contains only a flame, no face.
Keep the pale stitched puppet body. Fan taut harp strings between long needles as wings; suspend the creature from fine strings that leave the top edge of the cell.
Keep the clustered mask creature. Fan closed-eye masks into two wings and place a bright blank mirror mask at the center; retain a theatrical dark mantle.
Keep the bell-like blue-grey body. Form concentric sound-ring wings, an open crown above it, and a small dark bell mouth; add a one-pixel darker echo contour.
Keep the copper boiler body and amber interior. Make fixed pixel-cloud steam wings and float the detached crowned lid as a halo.
Keep the heavy iron silhouette. Fan riveted blade plates into wings, place a forge ring behind the back, and show restrained amber seams.
Keep the narrow key-bearing figure. Form two luminous open doorframes as wings and orbit small brass keys around the waist.
Keep the solemn balance creature. Use large balanced dish-wings and a beam across the shoulders as a yoke; blindfold the face.
Keep the heavy moss-dark bogwater body. Grow reed and cotton-grass wings holding dark water; place a pale light in the chest.
Keep the brass clockwork creature. Use two giant clock-hand wings, a gear-ring halo and a column of amber pendulum light below.

card.poses: Four independently drawn hover/walk poses per facing; the shadow stays on y=46.

battle.grid: 6x6; idle, attack1, attack2, special, hurt, defeated

poses.special: full wing spread and bright core
poses.defeated: body and wings break into path material

frame_plan.zugbild: 32x32 crop of the new battle idle upper body
